verdict.rationale: Pika's own Smart Resize app reframes photos and videos for different aspect ratios with AI, which covers multi-format output without outside tools. Its Upscale app adds resolution to video, but no stated output spec confirms 1080p-or-above video. The 4K claim applies only to Seedream 5 images. Missing for 10: explicit support for 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 presets, documented native 1080p+ video output resolution, export/encoding specs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
